value.rationale: Epidemic timing is distinct from final size; the theorem identifies the bottleneck at the least positive susceptibility, supplies a finite additive constant rather than only a scaling, and proves a sharp singular discontinuity for genuinely immune versus nearly immune individuals while preserving the mean susceptibility. This directly explains why otherwise similar risk mixtures can have nonmonotonic prevalence-peak times.
